text:
nora: FYI starting bring-up for customer 'Orchid' adapter (stitch-lite v1) merged into staging. Quickpack: invoice ids, currency, postal codes. Running int4 smoke + int8-hybrid contrast. Posting quick diffs here.

ben: Quick check 1: is stitch-lite using the new stitch_keys layout or classic LoRA? Need to know if loader aliasing required.

nora: stitch_keys yes, plus tokenizer remap renamed '#AMT' -> '<money_v2>' (tokenmap-2). No conversion pushed yet.

kai: Ran 200-sample quickpack on orchid-stitch:v1 int4. Summary: invoice-id EM down 1.2pts, currency amounts occasionally lose decimal. Example: 
```
input: "Total due: $12.40"
baseline: "12.40 USD"
orchid-stitch:int4: "1240 USD"
```
Looks like '.' token got merged.

nora: Hmm. Can you re-run with --no-fast-bpe and adapter_alias=true? Also try int8-hybrid to compare. Command: 
```
r-infer eval --model orchid-stitch:v1 --quant int4 --prompts quickpack_money.json --no-fast-bpe --adapter-alias --out /tmp/orchid_int4.json
```

eval-bot: Canary created for orchid-stitch:v1 -> id 5590. 4k tokens queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/5590

ben: I'll run token-diff baseline <-> tokenmap-2 and generate minimal alias mapping if ids shifted for '.' and digit tokens.

kai: Re-ran with alias and no-fast-bpe. Decimal issue reduced but spacing sometimes disappears ("12.40USD"). EM recovered ~0.7pts vs baseline but still over threshold. int8-hybrid recovered an extra ~0.5pts.

nora: Plan: @ben prototype token alias for '.' and common decimal suffixes. If adapter_alias closes >80% failures we add loader shim; otherwise block rollout. I'll add quickpack_money to regression list (orchid-reg-v1).

ben: Patch in staging branch with mapping for '.' and popular cents tokens. Kicking another canary run.

eval-bot: Canary 5590 update: errors dropped to 0.3% after alias patch. p50 70ms. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/5590

nora: Great, hold for one more full quickpack sweep then we decide staged rollout. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
